name: LionWifi
description: WiFi connection manager + ArduinoOTA + web filesystem browser + status page for ESP8266 and ESP32. Multi-SSID connect with auto-reconnect and AP rotation, optional router-ping reboot watchdog, NTP time, log rotation, OTA, and a SPIFFS/LittleFS/SD browser (list/upload/download/tail/delete) served over ESP8266WebServer or (ESP32) ESPAsyncWebServer/WebServer. The consumer defines three globals (the LionLogger Logger, the web server, and WifiConnector *_connector) and selects a filesystem with -D USE_SPIFFS or -D LFS. Single-instance, non-copyable. The ESP32 async web path also needs ESPAsyncWebServer + AsyncTCP.
keywords: wifi, ota, webserver, spiffs, littlefs, filesystem, browser, ntp, esp8266, esp32, arduino
